summary: Three Greptile review findings resolved: (1) SKILL.md recall/teach recipes now pass the question as a single-quoted opaque argument with an explicit never-embed note (was double-quoted, allowing shell command substitution); (2) promoted_states.go bbox flags use cmd.Flags().Changed instead of != 0.0 so an explicit 0.0 boundary (equator/prime meridian) is preserved; (3) flights --begin help text corrected to now-1h to match the implemented default (was now-2h).
reason: Greptile confidence score was 2/5 (threshold 4/5); the policy gate blocks merge until these land. All three are valid: the recipe interpolation is a command-injection vector for agents following the skill, the zero-value guards silently drop legitimate boundaries, and the stale help text misleads about the query window.
